findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read-url, read-pdf · Private data: compress, distilla-compress, semantic-search, read-pdf, wallet-balance, ocr, transcribe, smart-document, compliance-audit, comprimir, contar-tokens, doc-extract, summarize, count-tokens, translate-doc, wallet-base, ocr-business-cards · Public sink: ocr, vision, transcribe, content-pipeline, email-polish, blog-post-pipeline, email-campaign-pipeline, sales-email, reply, responder, combo-compet-market-email-70c7ad, combo-gtm-email-crypto-2e0abb, email-ventas · Destructive: semantic-search, ab-test-designer, base-ecosystem-report, crypto-payments-2026.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read-url, read-pdf · Private data: compress, distilla-compress, semantic-search, read-pdf, wallet-balance, ocr, transcribe, smart-document, compliance-audit, comprimir, contar-tokens, doc-extract, summarize, count-tokens, translate-doc, wallet-base, ocr-business-cards · Public sink: ocr, vision, transcribe, content-pipeline, email-polish, blog-post-pipeline, email-campaign-pipeline, sales-email, reply, responder, combo-compet-market-email-70c7ad, combo-gtm-email-crypto-2e0abb, email-ventas · Destructive: semantic-search, ab-test-designer, base-ecosystem-report, crypto-payments-2026

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
